reviews.title: No update for watch os27
reviews.text: I have loved this app for years and have been waiting patiently for them to update it to work on WatchOS 27 but as of this review they still haven’t. Having my list on my wrist as I walk the store and push the cart was phenomenal but today I’m removing it from my devices and finding a replacement.

reviews.title: Support is very poor
reviews.text: I am a lifelong member but support will not renew my member rate. When they asked for proof, I sent the last 5 years, now they are not responding. Seems as though it is their way or the highway. Cannot be trusted. Keep away. I will now look for alternatives.

reviews.title: 🔥🖤💔TOP but it doesn’t work!!! Fix it!
reviews.text: The app is awesome! I bought the PRO version right away! I’ve been using it for about 7 years. In the last 1–2 years, it hasn’t been syncing. It keeps showing “Connection…” on Android. On iPhone, it just doesn’t sync without any explanation. Please fix this!💔💔💔💔💔

reviews.title: Will not accept renewal payment
reviews.text: Keeps knocking me out when I try to renew. Obviously poorly maintained software.

reviews.title: Too sensitive
reviews.text: The screen is too sensitive. All it takes to add or subtract an item is a light touch - you know, like when you are just trying to scroll.  I’d give it many stars if they would change it to a slide gesture in order to move an item.

reviews.title: Cannot upgrade to Pro
reviews.text: After my payment method was wrongly declined, I am unable to reinstate my account to Pro and unable to change payment method I have  contacted the app 3 times and and no help. The app keeps crashing when I try to upgrade and my credit card works for everything else. Horrible customer support.I have used this app for years. What happened to you!I loved this app and used it every day

reviews.title: Sync issues
reviews.text: On a random day the list just stops syncing between devices

reviews.title: I really wanted this to work
reviews.text: I've been using IntelliList grocery app for years, and I really like it. But they've made some programming changes which I'm not thrilled about and it has gotten glitchy. I was looking for something new and was really hoping this app would be able to replace it. But, a feature I really need to have is the ability to have defined grocery aisles and be able to move those aisles around and put them in the order I want to mirror the store layout. This app just does not provide enough options for me. I'm sure if somebody just wants a simple list then it probably works fine. I want something more sophisticated.

reviews.title: Used to be great
reviews.text: This program used to be great. I preferred it over any other list program for shopping that was around. It integrated really well with Amazon Alexa. It understood what I wanted using voice. It was very accurate. But now some kind of update has been done and it’s forcing you to pay every month. I physically purchased this program a number of and now it’s requiring me to pay more. Don’t get this program. It’s worthless now.

reviews.title: Grocery list app has forgotten its one job
reviews.text: I’m not sure why my grocery list app incessantly advertises their subscription, limits the AMOUNT OF GROCERY LISTS I CAN HAVE, and pesters me constantly with banner ads and sponsored recommendations. At this point it’s easier to write my list on my arm than use this app which advertises so much it should be considered malware. I am certainly confused why I need a subscription to, and i cannot stress this enough, A GROCERY LIST APP. Just use a napkin and save yourself the headache.

reviews.title: Does not Sync
reviews.text: Despite paying for the pro account, the his app does not sync lists across devices.
